main_text.p: de Masorethis sententia factum est, ut Rabbini celebres in variis provinciis, libros diligenter pro genio corrigerent: id praestitit R. Ben Asher, quem Moses Bar Maimon Masorethis praetulit, & ad quem relictis Masorethis, librum tuum correxit, ut ipse testatur cap. 8. de libro legis; hac in causa Mosis verba sunt decretoria.

ולפי שראיתי שיבוש גרול ככל [?] המפרם שראיתי [?] בדברי אלו וכן בעלי [?] המשרת שבותבי ומחבכית להיריע [?] הבתו הות והכתומות גחלקו בדברים [?] אילו במחלו קות המפרים [illegible, ~2 letters] שממכיש [?] צלותנ [?]

Vides in his, quae sunt apud eos maximi momenti, in quo si error committatur, prophanus est, donec folium illud avellatur, omnes libros, quos vidit Moses, fuisse multum confusos. 2. Masorethas de hac re libros composuisse. 3. Magnam esse apud Masorethas de hac re litem & varietatem propter librorum, quos secuti sunt, differentiam; denique quod statim sequitur, libros illos deseruisse. & secutum in his Paraschis scribendis, &

page.notes: The Hebrew lines are read with doubt; every uncertain word is marked [?]. The box in the fifth Hebrew line is an empty printed gap, so it is marked illegible. The "&" at the bottom right is treated as a catchword. Small blots appear in "in variis" and in the Hebrew, and are not printed text. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j follow the vowel and consonant rule.
